title: Needs a closer look
localOnly: Local files only. No agent or external service is called.
preview: Check this selection against its connected code folder.
previewLimit: Up to {limit} code files, two recorded dependency steps, and short code excerpts. Nothing is changed or sent.
boundary: These are reasons to read, not verified defects or accepted relations.
unavailable: The code could not be read reliably.
connectHint: Check the connected code folder, or try again after the files stop changing. Anything missing, ambiguous, too large or changed is left unchecked.
sourceAccessRequired: This app needs permission to read the connected code folder.
sourceAccessHint: Select the connected folder: {path}. You will confirm the inspection afterward.
sourceSelectionFailed: Atlas could not use that folder selection. Select the connected code folder again.
sourceSelectionMismatch: This is not the connected code folder. Select the connected folder to continue.
webLimit: The browser cannot inspect the connected code folder. This local reader runs in the installed app.
webStillWorks: You can still read concept documents and follow recorded relations on the map.
stale: The code, the ontology or the folder connection changed. Check again to continue.
emptyLimit: This does not mean nothing was missed. Code that was not read or was left out, and unsupported behavior, stay unchecked.

kind.missing-link: Code reference absent from the dependency graph
kind.changed-source: Code changed behind a recorded dependency

importFact: A static code reference exists; its directed dependency is absent from the graph.
driftFact: The cited code has a later Git change than its concept document, and a concept is recorded as depending on it.
recordedUnknown: The author recorded this as unknown. It may be old; it has not been rechecked.
importUnknown: The prose may already explain it. Runtime coupling and business meaning remain unverified.
driftUnknown: A file change does not establish changed meaning or a broken dependent.
readGap: Does this unknown still apply? Compare the recorded sentence with the current code.
readImport: Does this call fit the existing explanation? Start with the caller and imported function.
readDrift: Does the changed code alter the stated promise? Compare that statement and its dependent caller.
noExactPath: No exact code path was recorded. Start with this concept's Uncertainty section.
prepareBoundary: This adds an editable message; it does not force read-only mode. Sending uses your chosen provider; writes still need your permission.
capturedSource: Read at {time}; a short excerpt, not the whole repository.
checking: Checking whether this code is still the same…
candidateCoverage: {total} suggestions · {omitted} after the first three. Sorted by closeness, then signal and slug.
scanUnavailable: The import scan did not run because its input could not be limited safely.
limited: Some code was over the read or scan limit. Nothing found here does not mean nothing is wrong.
coverageUnknown: Dynamic behavior and unsupported languages are not checked. Excerpts may leave out related lines. Callers and patterns outside the checked folders are not checked.
sourceFoldersUnknown: This check does not list its code folders, so it cannot show how much of the connected folder was covered.
sessionOnly: Hidden suggestions stay hidden for this check only. If the code changes, a new check starts.
draftOnly: Draft only. You decide whether to send it.
scopeBoundary: Concepts inside a selected project or domain are included; being inside one is not evidence of impact.
platformLimit: This check runs in the macOS app for now. On this platform the code is not checked; the map and documents still work.
copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
localFolderRequired: Open a local ontology folder to check its connected code. The sample has no local code folder.
draftLead:
{subject}
{question} Explain the current evidence and unknowns without changing files.

continuation.transfer: Sends this question and the selected code to {runtime}. Your agent may read more code and use its own provider, which may charge for it. Changes still need your permission.
continuation.reportedTasks: Agent-reported tasks: {done} of {total}. This is task status, not verified ontology coverage.
continuation.busy: The current conversation is working or waiting for your approval. Return to it before starting another analysis.
continuation.partial: This analysis stopped before all requested evidence was read. Review its findings and unknowns before choosing the next question.
continuation.result: Analysis result available. Its claims still need review; this does not mark the gap resolved.
continuation.previousResult: Previous result from {time}. The code or the ontology may have changed since; check again before using it for a change.
continuation.agentUnavailable: You need a ready coding agent that asks before writing. Choose one in the Agent panel, or prepare an editable prompt.
continuation.replanned: The agent changed its reported task total to {total}. Earlier task counts do not measure this revised plan or ontology completeness.
continuation.packetLimits: These limits describe the code already read. They do not limit the coding agent's later reads or cost. You can stop the analysis.
continuation.matchUnknown: This saved result cannot be matched to this question and evidence version. You can read it under Review results in the agent panel; it does not count as this scope’s analysis result.
continuation.refused: This check did not start. Check the selected code and the agent's permission mode, then try again.
continuation.improvementLead: Prepare a reviewable improvement for this question. Keep the answer’s unknowns and current evidence visible.
continuation.historyLimited: Some history was not read or could not be verified. Missing matches do not mean no earlier analysis exists.
continuation.narrowScope: This selection is unavailable or too large to check. Choose a smaller concept or set.
continuation.modelUnknown: The active model is not confirmed here. Check it in the Agent panel.
